$Comment: The Amateur chase's end-of-run spoils, rolled by the player's score when the round is won.
Rolls  - what everybody who wins takes home, whatever they scored.
Pool   - the part that varies. Pool.Rolls says how many picks the run earns: one to start,
plus one more per 1200 points (the weight is 1 divided by 1200), never more than 3.
Entries compete by Weight and are drawn with replacement, so one can come up twice.
The two readings the gates use are answered by the run itself: ziggfreedcommon:instance_score
is the player's score and ziggfreedcommon:instance_win is 1 on a win, 0 on a loss. Asked
anywhere there was no run, both are unanswerable and every gate over them stays shut.
To make a payout richer or poorer, retune the weights, the counts, or the score thresholds -
nothing here needs code. Another mod can ADD entries without touching this file by shipping
Name: chase_amateur
